breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains W2=100 m/s and beta2=30°, which gives Va2 = 100×cos(30°) ≈ 86.6 m/s, not 106 m/s. Simply asserting Va=106 m/s does not fix the inconsistency. The ground truth corrects W2 to ~122.5 m/s (= Va/cos(beta2)) to ensure axial velocity is truly constant. The agent failed to make this correction.
